_comment: Per-MTok prices in USD for Anthropic Claude models. SOURCE OF TRUTH for /jro-fable. Refresh by running lib/pricing-check.sh — it scrapes claude.com/pricing and reports drift, but does NOT auto-update (humans verify before edits). Last verified manually against the price list known to /jro-fable's SKILL.md.

claude-fable-5.notes: GA again 2026-07-01 (redeployed after June suspension). Adaptive thinking ALWAYS on (omit thinking param; depth via output_config.effort low|high|xhigh|max). No prefill, no sampling params, raw CoT never returned. Safety classifiers can return stop_reason:refusal — configure server-side fallback to claude-opus-4-8 (beta server-side-fallback-2026-06-01) for unattended runs. Own (smaller) rate-limit pool vs Opus. Requires 30-day data retention (ZDR orgs get 400). Reserve for frontier judgment: hardest long-horizon agentic work, highest-stakes synthesis.

claude-opus-4-8-fast.notes: Same Opus 4.8 model at up to 2.5x output speed (/fast in Claude Code, >=v2.1.36). 2x standard Opus price; on Pro/Max it bills usage CREDITS only, never plan-included usage. Enable at session start (mid-session toggle re-pays full uncached input once). For interactive latency-bound Opus-grade work only — never long autonomous runs, batch, or CI. Opus 4.7 fast mode is removed 2026-07-24.

claude-opus-4-8.notes: 2x cheaper than Fable. Strong on complex reasoning.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: EXECUTION seat since 26-0702. Near-Opus coding at 3-5x less cost (intro pricing ~5x). Adaptive thinking ON by default when thinking param omitted. Own rate-limit pool (separate from Sonnet 4.x). Fast latency-class already — prefer over fast-Opus when the task does not need Opus judgment.

claude-sonnet-4-6.notes: Superseded by Sonnet 5 for the EXECUTION seat 26-0702 (same list price, Sonnet 5 has intro discount + adaptive thinking). Active until at least 2027-02-17. Shares a rate pool with Sonnet 4.5.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.notes: 10x cheaper than Fable. For pattern matching, log scanning, bulk inventory. Break-even only if error rate stays <20%.

qwen3:8b.notes: Local via ~/bin/loc fast. Sub-3s on M5 Max. Bulk extraction, classification, grep-tier. The LOCAL tier floor.

qwen3:30b.notes: Local via ~/bin/loc (general). 5-15s on M5 Max. Default local worker.

qwen3:32b.notes: Local via ~/bin/loc big | lens | lingua. Editorial reviewer + bilingual parity. 10-30s on M5 Max.

qwen3-coder:30b.notes: Local via ~/bin/loc code | cr. First-pass code review before /harden or Sonnet.

nomic-embed-text.notes: Local via ~/bin/loc embed. 768-dim vectors for semantic recall. Free, instant.

tiers._comment: Canonical tier->model binding for /jro-fable. JUDGMENT auto-binds to the first AVAILABLE model in `prefer`; Fable 5 redeployed 2026-07-01 so the apex seat now holds Fable 5. Cost discipline: on subscription Claude Code the main loop is already Fable 5 (no marginal cost — use it for judgment, delegate down). On METERED API, default judgment to Opus 4.8 and escalate to Fable 5 only when frontier-hard (2x price, smaller rate pool, refusal-fallback needed). LOCAL tier added 260620 — free, on-machine on Jon's M5 Max via ~/bin/loc / lens / cr / lingua.

judgment.escalate_to_frontier_when: long-horizon agentic, hardest synthesis, conflict resolution where Opus disagrees with itself

local.notes: On-machine via Ollama. Sub-Haiku latency, $0, unlimited, offline. Try-first for bulk-verifiable work.

rules.effort_routing: Effort (low|high|xhigh|max) is the intra-model knob on the Claude 5 family + Opus 4.7+. Downshift EFFORT before downshifting MODEL on judgment work: Fable 5 at low effort often exceeds prior models at max. Workers doing mechanical stages get effort low; hardest verify/judge stages get xhigh. Higher effort up front often reduces total agentic cost via fewer turns.
rules.cache_rule: Cached reads do not count toward ITPM. Keep a route on ONE model with a stable prefix; spawn cheaper-model SUBAGENTS instead of switching models mid-session (switching invalidates cache).
